mapper.select: INSERT INTO source_registration (user_id, kind, input, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kind}, #{input}, #{note}) RETURNING id
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM app_user WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE) u
SELECT count(*) FROM source_registration WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created > #{since}
SELECT * FROM source_registration WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM source_registration WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM source_registration WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE source_registration SET state = 'IDENTIFIED', outcome = #{outcome}, source_id = #{sourceId}, tier_at_identification = #{tier}, identified_at = now(), reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'IDENTIFYING'
UPDATE source_registration SET state = 'NOT_IDENTIFIED', reason = #{reason}, identified_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'IDENTIFYING'
mapper.select: UPDATE source_registration SET state = 'WITHDRAWN' WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND state <> 'WITHDRAWN' RETURNING source_id
SELECT id FROM source_registration WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND kind = #{kind} AND input = #{input} AND state IN ('IDENTIFYING','IDENTIFIED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE source_registration SET user_id = #{to} WHERE user_id = #{from}
mapper.select: WITH due AS ( SELECT r.id, CASE WHEN s.tier = 'EXCLUDED' THEN 'DECLINED' ELSE 'ACCEPTED' END AS decision FROM source_registration r JOIN source s ON s.id = r.source_id WHERE r.state = 'IDENTIFIED' AND r.tier_at_identification = 'CANDIDATE' AND r.decision IS NULL AND s.tier IN ('CORE','BROAD','EXCLUDED') ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF r SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE source_registration r SET decision = due.decision, decision_at = now() FROM due, source s WHERE r.id = due.id AND s.id = r.source_id RETURNING r.id, r.user_id, r.input, r.decision, r.source_id, s.title
SELECT r.id, r.kind, r.input, r.source_id, s.title ORDER BY r.identified_at, r.id LIMIT #{limit}
